solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Room at the top in construction just starting

indicators.note: the top of a word in this sense is its opening letter, here taken from the word 'the'
only the starting letters of the words in and construction are wanted

explanation.surface: A builder points out the loft room going in at the top of a house still under construction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Room at the top' reads as the definition, but only 'Room' defines; 'the top' is the opening letter of 'the', and 'just starting' takes the first letters of 'in construction'.
explanation.definitionFit: A space directly under the roof of a house is a kind of room, so the loft is an example.

clue.text: Part of supermarket area surrounded by water, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is a word spoken, so the letters entered match its sound rather than its spelling

parts.note: an isle is a piece of land with water all round it

explanation.surface: A shopper describes a section of the supermarket cut off by a flood.
explanation.definitionFit: Shops are laid out in walkways between shelves, each one a part of the store.

clue.text: Painting elevated over poetry — getting cross!

indicators.note: in a down entry the first piece sits above the second
in a down entry, raising a word makes it read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: painting is a form of art
verse means poetry

explanation.surface: A picture is hung above some verses, and someone gets annoyed about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elevated' turns ART into TRA in this down entry. 'cross' looks like an adjective meaning angry but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To traverse ground is to travel across it, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Preserve operating rule

parts.note: to can food is to preserve it in tins
a machine that is operating is on

explanation.surface: A regulation about keeping the current procedures running.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is a general law or principle, especially a church law, so a synonym for a rule.

clue.text: Avoiding issue? Protection can potentially

indicators.note: the letters of these words could potentially be made into something else

explanation.surface: Using protection can help someone avoid having children.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring, and birth control is the means of avoiding having any.

clue.text: Our group back film

parts.note: we refers to a group that includes the speaker
the stern is the back part of a ship

explanation.surface: A club announces it is supporting a particular movie.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy picture is a genre of movie set in the American West.

clue.text: Row right after match

indicators.note: the abbreviation for right comes after the word for match

parts.note: a tie is a sporting match, as in a cup tie

explanation.surface: A quarrel breaks out once a game has ended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel but is a line of seats. A cup tie is a knockout game in British football.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one of a series of rows placed one above another, as in a stadium.

clue.text: See Dad excited at a Middle East location

indicators.note: something excited is stirred up, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A child urges someone to watch their father getting worked up at some place in the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: The salt lake between Israel and Jordan is a famous place in that region.

clue.text: Omit a teen troublesome once?

indicators.note: something troublesome is disorderly, so these letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Leave out a difficult adolescent just this once.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means formerly, at some point in the past, as once does.

clue.text: Mark, Saint, foremost of authors, popular

indicators.note: only the foremost letter of authors is taken

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A list of names reads like a saint and a popular author, with Mark first among them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a name in a list, as St Mark the gospel writer, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A stain is a discoloured spot or blemish, a kind of mark.

clue.text: Taught and reformed rude tot

indicators.note: something reformed has been formed again, so these letters are put into a new shape

explanation.surface: A badly behaved toddler was given lessons and improved.
explanation.definitionFit: To give private lessons is to teach, so the past tenses are synonyms.

clue.text: Lady, English, thin, Tory at heart

parts.note: lean means thin

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letters

explanation.surface: A slim English woman who is a Conservative deep down.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, so a lady is the category it belongs to.

clue.text: Business on the up, perhaps, broadcast policy

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it
a line is a policy or official position, as in the party line

explanation.surface: A growing company is put on the air with its strategy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the up' seems to mean thriving, but here it means literally up in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A flying carrier is a company whose trade takes place in the sky.

clue.text: Arrived during dreadful rain for such a hearing

definitions.note: the phrase describes how a hearing held privately takes place

indicators.note: one word comes within the other, as an arrival during a storm
something dreadful is in a bad state, so these letters are disordered

parts.note: came means arrived

explanation.surface: Someone turned up in terrible weather to attend a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' scrambles the weather word into INRA, and 'during' splits that after its second letter. The Latin phrase means in a private chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: A court hearing held in private, with press and public excluded, is held this way.

clue.text: Argument against Channel's behaviour

parts.note: a con is an argument against, as in pros and cons
a duct is a channel or tube; the apostrophe-s reads as 'is' joining the pieces

explanation.surface: Someone objects to how a TV channel has behaved.
explanation.definitionFit: Conduct as a noun means the way a person acts, a synonym of behaviour.

clue.text: One purring about simple floor show?

indicators.note: the first piece goes round, about the second

parts.note: a cat is an animal that purrs
bare means plain or simple

explanation.surface: A contented pet lies around on the floor as part of a modest show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One purring' looks like a person, but is a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightclub entertainment performed on the floor among diners is this kind of show.

clue.text: Inhibit lover, a Welshman? Not entirely

indicators.note: the letters appear inside these words without taking all of them

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether their boyfriend is perhaps only partly Welsh, and feels shy about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To overawe is to intimidate someone into silence, a way of holding them back.

clue.text: Postscript about Queen has reduced power maybe

indicators.note: the abbreviation for postscript goes about the other pieces

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

indicators.note: the word has is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: taken as written before it is shortened

explanation.surface: A note added to a letter says the monarch's power may have been cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' cuts the last letter from 'has', and 'about' wraps the postscript letters round everything else. ER stands for Elizabeth Regina.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are adverbs expressing possibility, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Fruit seeds on regular basis in upward slopes

indicators.note: letters are taken at a regular interval, every other one

explanation.surface: Fruit seeds are planted at regular intervals on hillsides.
explanation.definitionFit: A rise is a piece of rising ground, so the plural matches slopes going up.

clue.text: Tiny spot in glasses King needed for son

indicators.note: one letter is needed in place of another, a swap

parts.note: specs is informal for spectacles, or glasses

explanation.surface: A small mark on a pair of glasses that the King had to have for his son.
explanation.walkthrough: The swap replaces the final S of SPECS with K.
explanation.definitionFit: A speck is a very small particle or dot, a synonym of a tiny spot.

clue.text: On return trod around guy, sleeping

indicators.note: the reversed word goes around the other
a word on its return journey is read backwards

parts.note: a guy is a man

explanation.surface: Coming back, someone stepped round a man who was asleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On return' gives DORT, and 'around' makes it enclose the guy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dormant means inactive, as if asleep, so it matches sleeping as an adjective.

clue.text: Move fast in plant

definitions.meaning: a grass-like marsh plant with hollow stems

explanation.surface: Hurry when going into a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means hurry; the noun is a waterside plant used for matting.

clue.text: Instituted legal proceedings against eastern leather

parts.note: to have taken someone to court is to have sued them

explanation.surface: Someone took a tannery in the East to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Suede is leather with a napped, brushed finish, so a type of leather.

clue.text: Played lacrosse followed by European dish

indicators.note: the abbreviation for European comes after the mixed letters
something played is put into a new arrangement, so these letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Someone played a game of lacrosse and then had a European meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A casserole is a stew cooked slowly in the oven, a kind of dish.

clue.text: Swindler possibly succeeded — pay attention!

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
hark is an old command to listen

explanation.surface: A warning that a con man may have pulled it off, so listen up.
explanation.definitionFit: A card shark or loan shark is someone who cheats people, so a swindler is one example.
